selection_policy.present_marker_semantics: A present atom is diagnostic only; it suppresses that absence predicate but does not establish eligibility.

exactness_marker.description: A result hypothesis or summary explicitly records exactness, correctness, golden, token-match, or zero-difference evidence.

single_candidate_identity.description: Every result commit equals its expected head and all result envelopes identify one candidate commit.

isolated_stage_marker.description: A result hypothesis or summary explicitly identifies an isolated complete-chain timing stage.

exact_call_count_marker.description: An isolated-stage result explicitly records a numeric call, dispatch, invocation, layer, step, or forward count.

isolated_absolute_pair_marker.description: One isolated-stage result records base/old and candidate/new labels with at least two absolute duration values.

isolated_order_marker.description: One isolated-stage result explicitly records ABBA or BAAB order control.

isolated_uncertainty_marker.description: One isolated-stage result explicitly records confidence, interval, bootstrap, uncertainty, or error-bar evidence.

whole_stage_marker.description: A non-negated result fragment explicitly identifies completed whole-model timing and reports a prefill or decode measurement.

m4_hardware_marker.description: A whole-model result explicitly identifies M4 hardware.

matched_pair_marker.description: A whole-model result explicitly identifies base/candidate or ABBA/BAAB paired timing.

component_marker.description: A whole-model result explicitly identifies the prefill or decode component.

thermal_protocol_marker.description: A whole-model result explicitly identifies thermal, cooldown, cooling, or temperature control.
